name: KaiAI
highlights: Discord game leaderboard !topgame / !gameboard aggregates virtual-currency performance.
Public website without OAuth login; visitor-nickname chat protected by CSRF and anti-spam limits.
Live game leaderboard integrated into the public KaiAI dashboard.
Unknown prefix commands now explain how to open !help instead of being ignored.
Rewritten main.py: structured logging, cog discovery, graceful shutdown, presence rotation.
keep_alive.py health server with /healthz and /ready endpoints.
New System cog with global !help, !sysinfo, !invite and owner maintenance commands.
Centralised error handling for prefix and slash commands.
Fixed broken spy-log jump button in cogs/logs.py.
Removed duplicated infrastructure files from cogs/.
